name: National Technical University of Athens
summary: Athens technical university; engineering diplomas run ten semesters and are taught in Greek, with no English-taught bachelor's.

ib.text: EU citizen with the IB: apply in the Ministry's foreign-school graduates category (one parent not of Greek origin, last two school years abroad); no exam, ranked on certificate grade; Greek B2 needed to enrol.

lastYear.text: apply online 2–9 July; courier postmark by 10 July

apply.via: Ministry of Education form for foreign-school graduates

notes: Its own studies page says Greek high school graduates enter NTUA Schools through the national entrance examinations; the official language of instruction is Greek.
Erasmus exchange students can take courses with English reading and exams, but that is an exchange arrangement, not an English-taught degree.
